text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Grass-san! To commemorate 
the day, King will invite you to a 
first-class tea party! I shall show you 
hospitality with impeccable etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, an authentic tea party, is it~? Fufu, 
I'm already looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, as authentic as it gets! You've 
been practicing non-stop to make it 
'first-rate,' haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Having staring contests with videos and 
books~♪ Whisking bowl after bowl of matcha 
to taste test until I was totally wiped 
out~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Whaaat...! Why would you spoil it!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's the crystallization of King's blood, 
sweat, and tears, you know~♪ Do enjoy it, 
Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
From me, I offer up a Sei-chan-certified 
birthday taiyaki☆ Feel free to enjoy it at 
your top-class King tea party—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then Sei-chan should join us too for a 
first-class, authentic tea party. You 
don't mind, right, King-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eh, nah, I think I'll pass... I don't 
really get all the proper etiquette~ Plus, 
sitting seiza isn't really my thing...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, leave the etiquette to King♪ As for 
sitting seiza, 'as best as you can' is 
plenty fine! Let's celebrate Grass-san 
together, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Thank you... Please, go easy on 
me, I beg of you...
